name: Flame Strike
summary: Calls down a column of divine fire that deals Fire and Radiant damage.

stats.effect: A vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
stats.higherLevels: The Fire damage and the Radiant damage increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 5.
